I have been to a few CCD branches, but this was my first time visiting CCD Dadar. It is located near Shivaji Park, and to my surprise, the place was so cool and calm, even when I visited around 6:30 PM. They have both indoor and outdoor seating available. However, I had mentioned while ordering that I wanted it without ice, but it was still served with ice. I informed the staff, but instead of replacing it, they left me to remove the ice myself, which was disappointing. On the other hand, the latte was good and served at the perfect temperature.

I chose to sit outside, as I love outdoor seating, and I had a peaceful experience. The outdoor area is well-ventilated with fans, so it was comfortable. The staff was cooperative, and the washrooms were clean and compact.

This is a great cafe where you can come with friends, family, or even solo. You can sit, read a book, or work in a relaxed and quiet environment. Overall, I really liked the vibe of the cafe, but I feel the service could be improved, especially when it comes to handling customer preferences more carefully.

If you are in Dadar, it's still worth visiting for a cozy cafe experience.

On a rainy Sunday, I had the pleasure of visiting **Café Colony**, a charming Irani café located in Hindu Colony, Dadar. The weather itself was perfect for the experience, as the comforting aroma of freshly brewed tea and baked bread created a warm, nostalgic atmosphere. The café has that classic Irani charm, with its simple yet inviting interiors that make you feel at home the moment you step in.

I began with their famous **Irani chai and brun maska**, and it was everything I had hoped for. The chai was strong, perfectly balanced with milk and sugar, and paired beautifully with the soft-yet-crispy brun generously slathered with butter. It was the kind of combination that instantly lifts your mood on a rainy day. Next, I tried the **keema fry with pav**, which turned out to be another highlight of the visit. The keema was spiced just right—rich, hearty, and bursting with authentic flavor—while the pav was fresh and fluffy, making it a wholesome and satisfying dish.

To end the meal on a sweet note, I indulged in their famous **gaz sweet**, a delicacy that lived up to its reputation. Its unique taste and texture added a perfect finishing touch to the experience, leaving me with a lasting impression of the café’s culinary heritage.

What made the visit even more special was the interaction with the lady owner of Café Colony. She was warm, courteous, and genuinely interested in knowing how we enjoyed the food. During our conversation, I shared that I am from Delhi and thoroughly enjoyed experiencing these authentic Irani dishes in Mumbai. Her hospitality, combined with the food, made the outing truly memorable.

Overall, Café Colony is not just about food—it’s about warmth, tradition, and conversations. A must-visit gem in Dadar.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Signature Cold Coffee is definitely the best- rich, smooth, and perfectly balanced.
If you’re going on a Tuesday, they usually have a Buy 1 Get 1 offer. Their app is worth checking out too, you can get 50% off on referral and they sometimes offer subscription card deals (valid for 30 days), which is great if you’re a regular coffee drinker.
Seating space at the Matunga outlet is limited, so it’s better for quick visits or takeaways.
If you prefer hot coffee, definitely try the Hazelnut Latte.
Overall, great value for money and good offers if you use the app smartly.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a great experience at AB Coffee! The service was excellent, and I would especially like to appreciate Sayyad sir  for his outstanding hospitality. He was very polite, friendly, and attentive throughout our visit.

Highly recommend this place for both good coffee and great service!

featured_reviews.review_text: I accidentally bumped into an aromatic coffee brewing fragrance here. I ordered one hot chocolate one signature fold coffee. The only thing I don't like is no window. I feel a little bit suffocated here. Takeaway available. Overall a nice place. my experience here is good.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent Morning & Café Spot in Sion!
What I Ordered: Along with the great filter coffee, cranberry beer, and blueberry tea, I also tried their Blueberry Lychee with Popping Boba (as seen in image.png)—it was fantastic! The blueberry Poha is a must-try as well.
The Highlights: The morning time menu here is a real catch. The idli, dosa, and snacks are great. They also currently have an Alphanso Mango Festival menu running with items like Fresh Alphanso Shakes and Sundaes (as seen in image_3.png).
Service & Food Quality: I was highly impressed by the quick service and top-notch food quality.
Ambience: It is a very relaxing, modern, and comfortable environment to unwind or get some work done (as seen in image_2.png and image_4.png). There is also a nice outdoor seating view through the glass (as seen in image_5.png).
Cleanliness: The entire place is spotless, and even the toilets were exceptionally clean.
Highly recommended if you're in the Sion area!
